newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan revises down 96/97 domestic sales forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nissan revises down 96/97 domestic sales forecast.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Friday that it lowered its forecast for domestic vehicle sales in the year to March 31, 1997, to 1.14 million units, from a May forecast of 1.20 million.
Its domestic sales were 1.12 million units in 1995/96.
However, Japan's second biggest carmaker raised its forecast for 1996/97 vehicle exports to 585,000 units from a May forecast of 570,000, against 594,000 the year before.
"Our recreational vehicles are seeing good demand in Japan but the ratio of RVs in our overall product line-up is smaller than those of other makers," Nissan managing director Koichi Takagi said.
